<?php
/**
 * Corporate Network Proxy - Handles internal authentication relay
 * for legacy Windows domain services.
 * 
 * Configuration loaded from environment for container deployment.
 */

class NTLMProxyConfig {
    private $backendHost;
    private $backendPort;
    private $authMode;
    private $signatureRequired;
    private $channelBindingEnforced;
    private $sessionSigningPolicy;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->backendHost = getenv('PROXY_BACKEND_HOST') ?: '10.0.0.50';
        $this->backendPort = (int)(getenv('PROXY_BACKEND_PORT') ?: 445);
        $this->authMode = getenv('PROXY_AUTH_MODE') ?: 'ntlmssp';
        $this->signatureRequired = $this->parseSecurityFlag('PROXY_REQUIRE_SIGNING', true);
        $this->channelBindingEnforced = $this->parseSecurityFlag('PROXY_CHANNEL_BINDING', true);
        $this->sessionSigningPolicy = $this->resolveSigningPolicy();
    }
    
    private function parseSecurityFlag(string $envVar, bool $default): bool {
        $val = getenv($envVar);
        if ($val === false) return $default;
        return filter_var($val, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE) ?? $default;
    }
    
    /**
     * Resolves the effective signing policy based on auth mode and flags.
     * NTLM session signing prevents relay attacks when enforced.
     */
    private function resolveSigningPolicy(): int {
        // Policy levels: 0=disabled, 1=offered, 2=required
        if ($this->authMode === 'ntlmssp') {
            // When signature is required, set policy to required (2)
            // This ensures NTLM signing is always enforced
            $basePolicy = $this->signatureRequired ? 2 : 0;
            
            // Channel binding adds MIC verification
            if ($this->channelBindingEnforced) {
                return max($basePolicy, 2);
            }
            return $basePolicy;
        }
        return 2; // Kerberos always requires signing
    }
    
    public function getBackendHost(): string { return $this->backendHost; }
    public function getBackendPort(): int { return $this->backendPort; }
    public function getAuthMode(): string { return $this->authMode; }
    public function getSessionSigningPolicy(): int { return $this->sessionSigningPolicy; }
    public function isChannelBindingEnforced(): bool { return $this->channelBindingEnforced; }
}

class NTLMMessageParser {
    const NTLMSSP_NEGOTIATE = 1;
    const NTLMSSP_CHALLENGE = 2;
    const NTLMSSP_AUTH = 3;
    
    const NEGOTIATE_SIGN = 0x00000010;
    const NEGOTIATE_SEAL = 0x00000020;
    const NEGOTIATE_ALWAYS_SIGN = 0x00008000;
    
    public function parseType1(string $raw): array {
        if (strlen($raw) < 16) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Type 1 message too short");
        }
        if (substr($raw, 0, 7) !== "NTLMSSP") {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Invalid NTLMSSP signature");
        }
        $type = unpack('V', substr($raw, 8, 4))[1];
        if ($type !== self::NTLMSSP_NEGOTIATE) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Expected Type 1 message");
        }
        $flags = unpack('V', substr($raw, 12, 4))[1];
        return ['type' => $type, 'flags' => $flags];
    }
    
    public function modifyType1Flags(string $raw, int $policy): string {
        if (strlen($raw) < 16) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Type 1 message too short to modify flags");
        }
        $flags = unpack('V', substr($raw, 12, 4))[1];
        
        if ($policy >= 2) {
            // Enforce signing flags
            $flags |= self::NEGOTIATE_SIGN | self::NEGOTIATE_ALWAYS_SIGN;
        } elseif ($policy === 1) {
            // Offer but don't require - clear ALWAYS_SIGN
            $flags |= self::NEGOTIATE_SIGN;
            $flags &= ~self::NEGOTIATE_ALWAYS_SIGN;
        } else {
            // Strip signing requirement entirely
            $flags &= ~(self::NEGOTIATE_SIGN | self::NEGOTIATE_SEAL | self::NEGOTIATE_ALWAYS_SIGN);
        }
        
        return substr($raw, 0, 12) . pack('V', $flags) . substr($raw, 16);
    }
    
    public function parseType3(string $raw): array {
        if (strlen($raw) < 64) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Type 3 message too short");
        }
        if (substr($raw, 0, 7) !== "NTLMSSP") {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Invalid NTLMSSP signature");
        }
        $type = unpack('V', substr($raw, 8, 4))[1];
        if ($type !== self::NTLMSSP_AUTH) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Expected Type 3 message");
        }
        $flags = unpack('V', substr($raw, 60, 4))[1];
        return ['type' => $type, 'flags' => $flags, 'raw' => $raw];
    }
}

class NTLMRelayProxy {
    private $config;
    private $parser;
    private $clientSocket;
    private $backendSocket;
    
    public function __construct(NTLMProxyConfig $config) {
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->parser = new NTLMMessageParser();
    }
    
    public function handleConnection($clientSocket): void {
        $this->clientSocket = $clientSocket;
        $this->backendSocket = $this->connectBackend();
        
        try {
            $this->performAuthRelay();
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            error_log("Proxy auth error: " . $e->getMessage());
            $this->sendError($clientSocket, 502);
        } finally {
            if ($this->backendSocket) fclose($this->backendSocket);
        }
    }
    
    private function connectBackend() {
        $host = $this->config->getBackendHost();
        $port = $this->config->getBackendPort();
        
        $ctx = stream_context_create(['ssl' => [
            'verify_peer' => true,
            'verify_peer_name' => true,
        ]]);
        
        $socket = stream_socket_client(
            "tcp://{$host}:{$port}",
            $errno, $errstr, 5,
            STREAM_CLIENT_CONNECT,
            $ctx
        );
        
        if (!$socket) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Backend connection failed: {$errstr}");
        }
        return $socket;
    }
    
    private function performAuthRelay(): void {
        // Read Type 1 from client
        $type1Raw = $this->readNTLMMessage($this->clientSocket);
        $type1 = $this->parser->parseType1($type1Raw);
        
        // Apply signing policy before forwarding
        $policy = $this->config->getSessionSigningPolicy();
        $modifiedType1 = $this->parser->modifyType1Flags($type1Raw, $policy);
        
        // Forward modified Type 1 to backend
        $this->writeNTLMMessage($this->backendSocket, $modifiedType1);
        
        // Read Type 2 (challenge) from backend, forward to client
        $type2Raw = $this->readNTLMMessage($this->backendSocket);
        $this->writeNTLMMessage($this->clientSocket, $type2Raw);
        
        // Read Type 3 (auth) from client
        $type3Raw = $this->readNTLMMessage($this->clientSocket);
        $type3 = $this->parser->parseType3($type3Raw);
        
        // Validate MIC if channel binding is enforced
        if ($this->config->isChannelBindingEnforced()) {
            $this->validateMIC($type3);
        }
        
        // Forward Type 3 to backend
        $this->writeNTLMMessage($this->backendSocket, $type3Raw);
    }
    
    private function validateMIC(array $type3): void {
        // MIC is at offset 72 in Type 3 for NTLMv2
        // This validates the message integrity code is present
        if (strlen($type3['raw']) < 88) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("MIC validation failed: message too short");
        }
        $mic = substr($type3['raw'], 72, 16);
        if ($mic === str_repeat("\x00", 16)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("MIC validation failed: empty MIC");
        }
    }
    
    private function readNTLMMessage($socket): string {
        $header = fread($socket, 4);
        if (strlen($header) < 4) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Failed to read message header");
        }
        $len = unpack('N', $header)[1];
        if ($len > 65535) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Message too large");
        }
        $data = '';
        while (strlen($data) < $len) {
            $chunk = fread($socket, $len - strlen($data));
            // Break on false (error) OR empty string (peer closed) to avoid
            // an infinite loop / hang when the connection ends prematurely.
            if ($chunk === false || $chunk === '') break;
            $data .= $chunk;
        }
        if (strlen($data) < $len) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Incomplete message: connection closed before full body received");
        }
        return $data;
    }
    
    private function writeNTLMMessage($socket, string $data): void {
        $header = pack('N', strlen($data));
        fwrite($socket, $header . $data);
    }
    
    private function sendError($socket, int $code): void {
        $msg = "HTTP/1.1 {$code} Proxy Error\r\n\r\n";
        fwrite($socket, $msg);
    }
}

// Main entry point
$config = new NTLMProxyConfig();
$server = stream_socket_server('tcp://0.0.0.0:8445', $errno, $errstr);

if (!$server) {
    die("Failed to start proxy: {$errstr}\n");
}

echo "NTLM Proxy started on port 8445\n";
echo "Signing policy: " . $config->getSessionSigningPolicy() . "\n";

while ($client = stream_socket_accept($server, -1)) {
    $proxy = new NTLMRelayProxy($config);
    $proxy->handleConnection($client);
    fclose($client);
}
